mechanism: Turmeric (curcumin) may inhibit hepatic metabolism of isoniazid via CYP450 inhibition and compete for acetylation pathways, potentially increasing isoniazid levels and hepatotoxicity risk.
action: Monitor liver function tests (AST/ALT) and isoniazid efficacy; consider spacing doses or reducing turmeric supplementation; counsel patient to report signs of hepatotoxicity.
